name: Relay Gmail durable incremental sync
objective: Deliver one user-complete Gmail manual sync journey: bounded first sync, restart-safe incremental history, no partial cursor advance, explicit stale-history rebuild, readable recovery UI, and source-aligned proof. Grok is the default Worker; MiniMax is used once for the critical adapter so a real partial Candidate may be handed to Volcengine GLM if Main finds bounded remaining gaps.
